Scope: Measured production combat and support, budgets200/400/800, seeds1337/2026/4242, Fast/Crowd/Armored plus Blots and full eight-wave campaign. No player profile access. Applicability flags define missing role metrics. Damage is actual capped HP loss; no balance conclusion is inferred from theoretical DPS. NetResource is income minus purchases (campaign: generator purchases); RemainingInk records retained stock. Dominance compares damage, leaks, unresolved enemies, spending, object count, idle time and construction time for matching combat lanes. Cleaning comparisons include BlotsCleared and UnresolvedBlots across all matching lanes.
